exposure: Women with GDM vs. those without GDM, women with vs. without insulin therapy
outcome: Maternal complications (hospitalization, premature birth, preeclampsia, C-section, shoulder dystocia, postpartum complications)
Neonatal complications (large for gestational age, transfer to neonatal intensive unit, neonatal hypoglycemia)
cohort: 354 women with a pregestational BMI≥40kg/m2 with a singleton pregnancy from January 1996 to December 2014
finding: Morbidly obese women with GDM were at increased risk for premature birth, hospitalization, and had infants more likely to be large for gestational age and require NICU admission.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in the rate of C-section between women with and without GDM.
